definitions: A diminutive of the female given name Caroline.
A city, the county seat of Tuscola County, Michigan, United States.

blocks.text: Caro is a city in and the county seat of Tuscola County, Michigan, United States. The population was 4,328 at the 2020 census and 4,145 at the 2000 census.
Caro is a commune in the Morbihan department of Brittany in north-western France.
